headline: Egypt Chemical and Fertiliser Exports Rise 34% to $9.54B in 9M
summary: Egypt’s exports of chemical industries and fertilisers increased by 34% year-on-year to $9.54 billion in the first nine months of 2026, compared to $7.14 billion in the same period last year, according to the Chemical and Fertilisers Export Council.
why: Export performance in key industrial sectors serves as a crucial indicator of foreign currency generation and economic growth for emerging markets like Egypt.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Higher export revenues improve the country's trade balance and foreign currency inflows.
